overview_description.description: ​Krea offers a browser-based platform that integrates various generative AI models to facilitate the creation, editing, and customization of images and videos. The platform provides tools such as real-time image generation, video restyling, and 3D object creation, enabling users to produce and refine visual content. Krea's user base includes professionals from organizations like Pixar, LEGO, and Samsung.
